sources.snippet: Authorized Exoscale vLLM RCE PoC This public repository is an authorized, non-destructive security-lab proof of concept. With trust_remote_code, importing the custom configuration writes a marker under /tmp and sends a JSON callback to the researcher-controlled RequestRepo endpoint. It does not access credentials or customer data. The model weights and tokenizer are copied from sshleifer/tiny ...
